steps.en: Install the npm package and start the local server
steps.zh: 装 npm 包，启动本地服务

steps.en: Creates its data dir and SQLite DB, starts the Hermes bridge, opens the browser
steps.zh: 建数据目录和 SQLite 库，拉起 Hermes 桥接，打开浏览器

component.zh: Koa 服务 + Python 桥接

steps.en: Sign in, then pick the agents you use in Agent Manager
steps.zh: 登录，在 Agent Manager 里选你要用的 agent

steps.en: Installs and configures those coding-agent CLIs on the backend machine
steps.zh: 在后端机器上安装并配置这些编码 agent 的 CLI

steps.en: Chat with one agent, or @mention several agents in a group room
steps.zh: 和一个 agent 单聊，或在群聊房间里 @ 多个 agent

steps.en: Routes each run to that agent's adapter, streams replies and tool traces, saves the session
steps.zh: 把每次运行派给对应 agent 的适配器，流式回显回复与工具轨迹，存下会话

value.en: One local console for all your agents' sessions and files, instead of one terminal and one history per agent
value.zh: 所有 agent 的会话和文件都在一个本地控制台里，不再一个 agent 一个终端、一份历史

sources: README 'Quick Start > npm' (npm install -g ekko-studio; ekko-studio-web start; Open http://localhost:8648)
README 'Auto Configuration' (initializes Studio data directories, local databases and bundled skills; starts the Hermes agent bridge used by /chat-run; opens a browser)
README 'Authentication' (default bootstrap credentials are admin / 123456; users are prompted to change them after login)
README 'Coding Agents' (install, configure, launch and monitor Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Grok, OpenCode and DSH from the dashboard) and 'Agent Manager' screenshot caption
README 'Group Chat' (@mention routing — mention an agent to trigger a contextual reply)
README 'AI Chat' (real-time streaming over Socket.IO /chat-run; Studio dispatches each run through runtime adapters; self-built SQLite session database)
